block.qmd.atmosphere_collector.desc: Collects gas from the atmosphere. Checks a 5x5x5 Cube where it is the bottom of the center face for clear space.
block.qmd.liquid_collector.desc: Collects liquids from large bodies of liquid such as oceans and rivers. Checks a 5x5x5 Cube where it is the top of the center face for blocks.
death.attack.antimatter_annihilation: %1$s got too curious and was annihilated for it
death.attack.antimatter_launcher: %1$s was annihilated by %2$s with a Antimatter Launcher
death.attack.gluon_gun: %1$s was vaporized by %2$s with a Gluon Gun
death.attack.lepton_cannon: %1$s was killed by %2$s with a Lepton Cannon
gui.qmd.particlestack.name: Type: %s
item.qmd.beam_meter.desc: Measures the stats of a Beamline or Beam Port. If measuring a Beamline the stats are the end of the beamline.
item.qmd.potassium_iodine_tablet.desc: Gives temporary radiation immunity. Don't take too many!
qmd.guide_book.desc: This is a Guide to Quantum Minecraft Dynamics.
qmd.guide_book.name: QMD Guide
qmd.multiblock_validation.accelerator.in: A Beam Port can not be here.
qmd.multiblock_validation.accelerator.li: There must be a Ion Source at one end of the beam and a Beam Port at the other.
Linear Accelerators must be 5 blocks wide.
There must be a straight line of Accelerator Beam blocks down the middle of the Linear Accelerator.
There must be a Accelerator Beam Port INPUT and OUTPUT at either end of the beam.
There can only be one Ion Source.
The Ion Source must face inwards at the beam.
There can only be a Beam Port at the ends of the beam.
Linear Accelerator is not long enough.
qmd.multiblock_validation.accelerator.ma: The Ion Collector must face inwards.
There is already a Ion Source on this vertical layer.
The Ion Source must face inwards.
This is not a valid position for a Ion Source. Ion Sources must be placed one block up on the side of every second vertical layer along the length of the mass spectrometer.
This type of Accelerator Ion Source is not allowed for a Mass Spectrometer.
This type of Accelerator Electromagnet is not allowed for a Mass Spectrometer.
This must be an Accelerator Beam Block.
This must be an Ion Collector. There must be 4 Ion Collectors above every Ion Source.
This must be an Accelerator Electromagnet.
Mass Spectrometers must be an odd number of blocks long.
There can only be one type of Accelerator Electromagnet in a Mass Spectrometer.
This must be an Accelerator Electromagnet Yoke.
There must be 4 Ion Collectors above every Ion Source, not anywhere else.
There must be one Ion Source on every second vertical layer along the length of the Mass Spectrometer. For this size Mass Spectrometer there Must be %s Ion Sources.
Mass Spectrometers must be 7 blocks tall.
Mass Spectrometers must be 7 blocks wide in at least one direction.
qmd.multiblock_validation.accelerator.no: There cannot be any Ion Collectors on this type of accelerator.
There cannot be any Ion Source Ports on this type of accelerator.
There cannot be any RF Cavities in this type of accelerator.
There cannot be any Ion Sources on this type of accelerator.
There cannot be any Synchrotron Ports on this type of accelerator.
There cannot be any Electromagnet Yokes in this type of accelerator.
qmd.multiblock_validation.accelerator.ri: There must be a Beam Block to Connect the Beam Port.
There must be a square ring of Accelerator Beam blocks down the middle of the Accelerator.
There must be a dipole where a Beam Port enters.

There must be a dipole in every corner of the accelerator. A dipole is made by placing a Accelerator Electromagnet on the top and bottom of a Accelerator Beam, then surrounding the it with Accelerator Electromagnet Yokes.
Beam Ports must be on the same Y level as the beam ring.
The Accelerator must have the same length in the X and Z direction.
There must be only one INPUT and OUTPUT Beam Port.
There can only be one Synchrotron Port.
Synchrotron Accelerator is not large enough.
qmd.multiblock_validation.accelerator.so: You got a Beam Port with no facing. Well how did you manage to do that?
qmd.multiblock_validation.accelerator.sp: There must be one INPUT and two OUTPUT Beam Ports.
There must have a Accelerator Beam Block at the center.
The Beam Diverter must be a 5x5x5 Cube with a dipole in the center.
There Must be a vertical or horizontal dipole at the center.
qmd.multiblock_validation.chamber.beam_d: There must be an OUTPUT Fluid Port on a Beam Dump.
There can only be 1 INPUT Beam Port on a Beam Dump.
qmd.multiblock_validation.chamber.beam_p: Beam Ports must be at the center of a horizontal face.
qmd.multiblock_validation.chamber.must_b: There must be a line of Particle Chamber Beam Blocks from each Beam Port to the Particle Chamber.
Chamber must have an odd width.
Chamber must have the same X and Z dimensions.
qmd.multiblock_validation.chamber.must_h: There must be 1 INPUT Beam Port.
Must have a Particle Chamber at the center.
qmd.multiblock_validation.chamber.no_bea: There cannot be any Particle Chamber Beams in this type of particle chamber.
qmd.multiblock_validation.chamber.no_det: There cannot be any Detectors in this type of particle chamber.
qmd.multiblock_validation.chamber.no_flu: There cannot be any Fluid Ports on this type of particle chamber.
qmd.multiblock_validation.chamber.no_ite: There cannot be any Item Ports on this type of particle chamber.
qmd.multiblock_validation.collision_cham: There are too many Beam Ports. There must be 2 INPUT Particle Chamber Beam Ports and 4 OUTPUT Particle Chamber Beam Ports.
This must be a Particle Chamber Beam Block.
This must be an INPUT Particle Chamber Beam Port.
The end faces must be squares of odd side length.
This must be an OUTPUT Particle Chamber Beam Port.
There must be a straight line of Particle Chamber blocks down the middle of the Collision chamber.
Collision Chamber must be 17 blocks long.
qmd.multiblock_validation.exotic_contain: There must be a Beam Port or Laser at the center of the face.
There must be a ring of Vacuum Chamber Coils at the top and bottom.
This block must be an empty space.
There must be a INPUT Beam Port at the center of the face.
There must be a Laser at the center of the face.
Exotic Containment must have an odd width.
Exotic Containment must have the same X and Z dimensions.
There can only be 2 INPUT Beam Ports.
There can only be 2 Vacuum Chamber Lasers.
qmd.multiblock_validation.liquefier.comp: Compressors must be located on the top face of the multiblock.
qmd.multiblock_validation.liquefier.inle: Heat Exchanger Inlets and Heat Exchanger Outlets must be above the two bottom interior layers.
qmd.multiblock_validation.liquefier.inva: There must be at least the same amount of Liquefier Compressors as Liquefier Nozzles.
Each Liquefier Expansion Nozzle must be connected to a compressor by heat exchanger tubes.
qmd.multiblock_validation.liquefier.must: The layer above the bottom interior layer must be made of Heat Exchanger Baffles or Liquefier Expansion Nozzles.
The bottom interior layer must be empty.
There must be at least one Liquefier Energy Port.
There must be at least one INPUT Liquefier Port.
There must be at least one OUTPUT Liquefier Port.
qmd.multiblock_validation.need_energy_po: There must be at least 1 Energy Port.
qmd.multiblock_validation.no_inlet: There must be at least 1 Coolant Vent INPUT.
qmd.multiblock_validation.no_outlet: There must be at least 1 Coolant Vent OUTPUT.
qmd.multiblock_validation.nucleosynthesi: This must be a Vacuum Chamber Beam Block.
This must be an empty space.
This can only be a Vacuum Chamber Heater block or an empty space.
There must be only 1 INPUT Beam Port either here or in the same position on the opposite face.
This must be an INPUT Fluid Port
This must be an OUTPUT Fluid Port
This must be a Vacuum Chamber Plasma Glass block.
This must be a Vacuum Chamber Plasma Nozzle block that is facing in.
There must be 2 INPUT Fluid Ports and 2 OUTPUT Fluid Ports.
There must be at least 1 INPUT Heater Vent.
There must be at least 1 OUTPUT Heater Vent.
Nucleosynthesis Chamber must be size 11x5 with height of 7.
There must be only 1 INPUT Beam Port and no OUTPUT Beam Ports.
qmd.multiblock_validation.vacuum_chamber: There cannot be any Fluid Ports on this type of vacuum chamber.
There cannot be any Heater Vents in this type of vacuum chamber.
There cannot be any Item Ports on this type of vacuum chamber.
There cannot be any Vacuum Chamber Lasers in this type of vacuum chamber.
qmd.particle.alpha.desc: Alpha Particle is another name for the nucleus of helium 4. It is commonly released in the decay of heavy elements like uranium and plutonium.
qmd.particle.alpha.name: Alpha Particle
qmd.particle.antialpha.desc: The Anti-Alpha Particle is the antimatter partner of the Alpha Particle.
qmd.particle.antialpha.name: Anti-Alpha Particle
qmd.particle.antibottom_quark.desc: The Anti-Bottom Quark is the antimatter partner of the Bottom Quark.
qmd.particle.antibottom_quark.name: Anti-Bottom Quark
qmd.particle.anticharm_quark.desc: The Anti-Charm Quark is the antimatter partner of the Charm Quark.
qmd.particle.anticharm_quark.name: Anti-Charm Quark
qmd.particle.antidelta_minus.desc: Anti-Delta - is a baryon containing three Anti-Down Quarks. They quickly decay via the strong force.
qmd.particle.antidelta_minus.name: Anti-Delta -
qmd.particle.antidelta_plus_plus.desc: Anti-Delta ++ is a baryon containing three Anti-Up Quarks. They quickly decay via the strong force.
qmd.particle.antidelta_plus_plus.name: Anti-Delta ++
qmd.particle.antideuteron.desc: The Anti-Deuteron is the antimatter partner of the Deuteron.
qmd.particle.antideuteron.name: Anti-Deuteron
qmd.particle.antidown_quark.desc: The Anti-Down Quark is the antimatter partner of the Up Down.
qmd.particle.antidown_quark.name: Anti-Down Quark
qmd.particle.antihelion.desc: The Anti-Helion is the antimatter partner of the Helion.
qmd.particle.antihelion.name: Anti-Helion
qmd.particle.antikaon_naught.desc: The Anti-Kaon 0 is a meson with strangeness of -1.
qmd.particle.antikaon_naught.name: Anti-Kaon 0
qmd.particle.antimuon.desc: The Anti-Muon is the antimatter partner of the Muon.
qmd.particle.antimuon.name: Anti-Muon
qmd.particle.antineutron.desc: The Anti-Neutron is the antimatter partner of the Neutron.
qmd.particle.antineutron.name: Anti-Neutron
qmd.particle.antiproton.desc: The Anti-Proton is the antimatter partner of the Proton.
qmd.particle.antiproton.name: Anti-Proton
qmd.particle.antisigma_minus.desc: Anti-Sigma Baryons contain one Anti-Strange Quark. They are heavier than Anti-Protons and Anti-Neutrons.
qmd.particle.antisigma_minus.name: Anti-Sigma -
qmd.particle.antisigma_naught.desc: Anti-Sigma Baryons contain one Anti-Strange Quark. They are heavier than Anti-Protons and Anti-Neutrons.
qmd.particle.antisigma_naught.name: Anti-Sigma 0
qmd.particle.antisigma_plus.desc: Anti-Sigma Baryons contain one Anti-Strange Quark. They are heavier than Anti-Protons and Anti-Neutrons.
qmd.particle.antisigma_plus.name: Anti-Sigma +
qmd.particle.antistrange_quark.desc: The Anti-Strange Quark is the antimatter partner of the Strange Quark.
qmd.particle.antistrange_quark.name: Anti-Strange Quark
qmd.particle.antitau.desc: The Anti-Tau is the antimatter partner of the Tau.
qmd.particle.antitau.name: Anti-Tau
qmd.particle.antitop_quark.desc: The Anti-Top Quark is the antimatter partner of the Top Quark.
qmd.particle.antitop_quark.name: Anti-Top Quark
qmd.particle.antitriton.desc: The Anti-Triton is the antimatter partner of the Triton.
qmd.particle.antitriton.name: Anti-Triton
qmd.particle.antiup_quark.desc: The Anti-Up Quark is the antimatter partner of the Up Quark.
qmd.particle.antiup_quark.name: Anti-Up Quark
qmd.particle.boron_ion.desc: A Boron atom with one electron missing.
qmd.particle.boron_ion.name: Boron Ion
qmd.particle.bottom_eta.desc: Eta Mesons are flavorless mesons meaning their flavor numbers like strangeness and isospin are 0.
qmd.particle.bottom_eta.name: Bottom Eta Meson
qmd.particle.bottom_quark.desc: The Bottom Quark is a very heavy version of the Down Quark.
qmd.particle.bottom_quark.name: Bottom Quark
qmd.particle.calcium_48_ion.desc: A Calcium-48 atom with one electron missing. This is a particularly neutron rich atom useful for creating Super heavy elements.
qmd.particle.calcium_48_ion.name: Calcium-48 Ion
qmd.particle.charm_quark.desc: The Charm Quark is a heavy version of the Up Quark.
qmd.particle.charm_quark.name: Charm Quark
qmd.particle.charmed_eta.desc: Eta Mesons are flavorless mesons meaning their flavor numbers like strangeness and isospin are 0.
qmd.particle.charmed_eta.name: Charmed Eta Meson
qmd.particle.delta_minus.desc: Delta - is a baryon containing three Down Quarks. They quickly decay via the strong force.
qmd.particle.delta_minus.name: Delta -
qmd.particle.delta_plus_plus.desc: Delta ++ is a baryon containing three Up Quarks. They quickly decay via the strong force.
qmd.particle.delta_plus_plus.name: Delta ++
qmd.particle.deuteron.desc: The Deuteron is the nucleus of a Deuterium Atom.
qmd.particle.deuteron.name: Deuteron
qmd.particle.down_quark.desc: The Down Quark is the second lightest quark. Up and Down quarks combine to form Protons and Neutrons
qmd.particle.down_quark.name: Down Quark
qmd.particle.electron.desc: The Electron is lightest charged lepton. It is commonly found in orbitals around nuclei, forming atoms.
qmd.particle.electron.name: Electron
qmd.particle.electron_antineutrino.desc: The Electron Antineutrino is the antimatter partner of the Electron Neutrino.
qmd.particle.electron_antineutrino.name: Electron Antineutrino
qmd.particle.electron_neutrino.desc: The Electron Neutrino is the neutrino partner of the Electron.
qmd.particle.electron_neutrino.name: Electron Neutrino
qmd.particle.eta.desc: Eta Mesons are flavourless mesons meaning their flavor numbers like strangeness and isospin are 0.
qmd.particle.eta.name: Eta Meson
qmd.particle.eta_prime.desc: Eta Mesons are flavorless mesons meaning their flavor numbers like strangeness and isospin are 0.
qmd.particle.eta_prime.name: Eta Prime Meson
qmd.particle.glueball.desc: Glueballs are particle made entirely out of gluons.
qmd.particle.glueball.name: Glueball
qmd.particle.gluon.desc: Gluons are the carries of the strong force. The strong force is what keeps quarks bound together to create composite particles like protons and neutrons.
qmd.particle.gluon.name: Gluon
qmd.particle.helion.desc: The Helion is the nucleus of a Helium-3 Atom.
qmd.particle.helion.name: Helion
qmd.particle.higgs_boson.desc: The Higgs Boson is the boson of the Higgs Field which is responsible for giving particles their mass.
qmd.particle.higgs_boson.name: Higgs Boson
qmd.particle.kaon_minus.desc: The Kaon - is a meson with strangeness of -1.
qmd.particle.kaon_minus.name: Kaon -
qmd.particle.kaon_naught.desc: The Kaon 0 is a meson with strangeness of 1.
qmd.particle.kaon_naught.name: Kaon 0
qmd.particle.kaon_plus.desc: The Kaon + is a meson with strangeness of 1.
qmd.particle.kaon_plus.name: Kaon +
qmd.particle.muon.desc: The Muon is basically a heavy electron.
qmd.particle.muon.name: Muon
qmd.particle.muon_antineutrino.desc: The Muon Antineutrino is the antimatter partner of the Muon Neutrino.
qmd.particle.muon_antineutrino.name: Muon Antineutrino
qmd.particle.muon_neutrino.desc: The Muon Neutrino is the neutrino partner of the Muon.
qmd.particle.muon_neutrino.name: Muon Neutrino
qmd.particle.neutron.desc: The Neutron is a Nucleon along with the Protons make up the nucleus of atoms. The Neutron is used in nuclear fission to split fissile nuclei.
qmd.particle.neutron.name: Neutron
qmd.particle.none.name: None
qmd.particle.photon.desc: Photons are the particles that make up light. They are the carries of the electromagnetic force. High energy Photons are called gamma rays.
qmd.particle.photon.name: Photon
qmd.particle.pion_minus.desc: Pions are the particles that are responsible for holding nuclei together. Although not colored themselves they distribute the "residual" strong force to keep nuclei together.
qmd.particle.pion_minus.name: Pion -
qmd.particle.pion_naught.desc: Pions are the particles that are responsible for holding nuclei together. Although not colored themselves they distribute the "residual" strong force to keep nuclei together.
qmd.particle.pion_naught.name: Pion 0
qmd.particle.pion_plus.desc: Pions are the particles that are responsible for holding nuclei together. Although not colored themselves they distribute the "residual" strong force to keep nuclei together.
qmd.particle.pion_plus.name: Pion +
qmd.particle.positron.desc: The positron is the Antimatter particle of the electron. When a electron and positron meet the annihilate resulting in all there mass being converted into energy in the form of 2 gamma rays.
qmd.particle.positron.name: Positron
qmd.particle.proton.desc: The Proton is a Nucleon along with the Neutron make up the nucleus of atoms.
qmd.particle.proton.name: Proton
qmd.particle.sigma_minus.desc: Sigma Baryons contain one Strange Quark. They are heavier than Protons and Neutrons.
qmd.particle.sigma_minus.name: Sigma -
qmd.particle.sigma_naught.desc: Sigma Baryons contain one Strange Quark. They are heavier than Protons and Neutrons.
qmd.particle.sigma_naught.name: Sigma 0
qmd.particle.sigma_plus.desc: Sigma Baryons contain one Strange Quark. They are heavier than Protons and Neutrons.
qmd.particle.sigma_plus.name: Sigma +
qmd.particle.strange_quark.desc: The Strange Quark is a heavy version of the Down Quark.
qmd.particle.strange_quark.name: Strange Quark
qmd.particle.tau.desc: The Tau is basically a really heavy electron
qmd.particle.tau.name: Tau
qmd.particle.tau_antineutrino.desc: The Tau Antineutrino is the antimatter partner of the Tau Neutrino.
qmd.particle.tau_antineutrino.name: Tau Antineutrino
qmd.particle.tau_neutrino.desc: The Tau Neutrino is the neutrino partner of the Tau.
qmd.particle.tau_neutrino.name: Tau Neutrino
qmd.particle.top_quark.desc: The Top Quark is a very heavy version of the Up Quark.
qmd.particle.top_quark.name: Top Quark
qmd.particle.triton.desc: The Triton is the nucleus of a Tritium Atom.
qmd.particle.triton.name: Triton
qmd.particle.up_quark.desc: The Up Quark is the lightest quark. Up and Down quarks combine to form Protons and Neutrons
qmd.particle.up_quark.name: Up Quark
qmd.particle.w_minus_boson.desc: The Z and W bosons are the carries of the weak force. The weak force is what allows some particles to decay and is responsible for beta decay.
qmd.particle.w_minus_boson.name: W- Boson
qmd.particle.w_plus_boson.desc: The Z and W bosons are the carries of the weak force. The weak force is what allows some particles to decay and is responsible for beta decay.
qmd.particle.w_plus_boson.name: W+ Boson
qmd.particle.z_boson.desc: The Z and W bosons are the carries of the weak force. The weak force is what allows some particles to decay and is responsible for beta decay.
qmd.particle.z_boson.name: Z Boson
tile.qmd.accelerator_magnet.desc: Bends the path of charged particles with a strong magnetic field. Can be used to make a Quadrupole or Dipole magnet. For a Quadrupole magnet a beam must be surrounded by 4 of the same type of electromagnets.
tile.qmd.accelerator_yoke.desc: Shapes and strengthens the magnetic field of an electromagnet. Used to make a Dipole magnet. For a dipole magnet a beam must have a electromagnet on the top and bottom then all space not taken by beams in a 3x3 around the central beam must be filled with electromagnet yokes.
tile.qmd.ion_source.desc: Makes ions and particles for accelerators.
tile.qmd.liquefier_compressor.desc: Compresses gas to be then expanded and cooled into a liquid. Must be place on the top of the liquefier.
tile.qmd.particle_chamber.detector.bubbl: Must be placed within 2 blocks of a Particle Chamber.
tile.qmd.particle_chamber.detector.em_ca: Must be placed within 3 blocks of a Particle Chamber.
tile.qmd.particle_chamber.detector.hadro: Must be placed within 5 blocks of a Particle Chamber.
tile.qmd.particle_chamber.detector.in.de: Must be placed within %s blocks of a Particle Chamber.
tile.qmd.particle_chamber.detector.out.d: Must be placed equal or more than %s blocks away from a Particle Chamber.
tile.qmd.particle_chamber.detector.silic: Must be placed next to a Particle Chamber.
tile.qmd.particle_chamber.detector.wire_: Must be placed within 2 blocks of a Particle Chamber.
tile.qmd.rf_cavity.desc: Accelerates charged particles with a Radio Frequency electric field. Must be made as a ring of 8 RF cavities of the same type surrounding a beam. Cannot be next to another RF cavity.
zerocore.api.nc.multiblock.validation.ca: This block position cannot be part of the multiblock.
